observedEvidence: Current q9 asks which monomial expressions are correct; solution checks coefficient products/quotients and exponent addition/subtraction.

Active compiled subUnit records under standardUnitKey M2-01: M2-01-EXPONENT_LAW (label 지수법칙), M2-01-POLYNOMIAL_OPERATIONS (label 다항식의 계산), and M2-01-REPEATING_DECIMAL (label 유리수와 순환소수). The last key is semantically unrelated.

holdEvidence.nextRequiredEvidenceOrCapability: A canonical owner must either (a) approve and compile an M2-01 child subUnit key/label specifically mapped to RPM L3-2.1.2, with parent, curriculum scope, and source evidence, or (b) provide an approved explicit crosswalk proving an existing active subUnit is the exact safe projection for monomial multiplication/division.
